title: Ansel and the Crown
author: Edmund Oyelaran
blurb: Bram Amberdale, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
